title: Loss Settlement Terms Table — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Each tier of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) carries a fixed basis for settling building and contents losses, together with the loss-avoidance and removal-to-safety terms.

| Tier | Building losses settled at | Coinsurance penalty applies | Coinsurance percentage | Contents losses settled at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | actual cash value | no | 0 | actual cash value |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | actual cash value | no | 0 | actual cash value |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | actual cash value | no | 0 | actual cash value |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | actual cash value | no | 0 | actual cash value |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | replacement cost | yes | 80 percent | actual cash value |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | replacement cost | yes | 80 percent | actual cash value |

The coinsurance percentage is the share of the replacement cost value that the building limit must reach (or the statutory building cap, whichever is lower) to avoid the coinsurance penalty; it is 0 where coinsurance does not apply.

| Tier | Loss-avoidance reimbursement maximum (USD, no deductible) | Days property removed to safety stays covered | Basement contents covered beyond the listed basement items |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 1000 | 45 | no |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 1000 | 45 | no |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 1000 | 45 | no |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 1000 | 45 | no |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 1000 | 45 | no |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 1000 | 45 | no |

- **Loss avoidance.** Sandbags, fill and pumping supplies bought to protect insured property are reimbursed up to 1000, with no deductible, on every tier.
- **Removal to safety.** Insured property moved away to protect it from flood stays covered at the safe location for 45 calendar days.
- **Basements.** On no tier are contents kept in a basement covered beyond the listed basement items.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical).** On an RCBAP tier the coinsurance requirement is 80 percent: for a stated replacement cost value of 1,000,000 the 80 percent share is 800,000; on a General Property Form tier no coinsurance requirement exists because the percentage is 0.

## Parameter meanings

- Basis on which building losses are settled; enum (actual cash value, replacement cost).
- Whether a coinsurance penalty applies when the building is under-insured; boolean.
- Share of replacement cost value the building limit must reach (or the statutory building cap, whichever is lower) to avoid the coinsurance penalty; percent (0 where coinsurance does not apply). *Scoped exception:* For a building amount sworn on a building proof of loss, and only for such an amount, the replacement cost value the required insurance is measured against is the building's value at the time of loss, as settled for a building proof of loss; the required insurance in a building payment or in any other settlement remains measured against the replacement cost value shown on the policy.
- Basis on which contents losses are settled; enum (actual cash value). *Scoped exception:* For a contents amount sworn on a contents proof of loss, and only for such an amount, the contents loss at actual cash value is first held to the contents value ceiling, then the contents deductible is subtracted, the remainder is never below zero and never above the contents limit, and it covers only the property the tier's contents owner basis describes; every other contents settlement remains at actual cash value less the contents deductible, never below zero, capped at the contents limit.
- Maximum reimbursement for sandbags, fill and pumping supplies bought to protect insured property, with no deductible; USD.
- Days that insured property moved away to protect it from flood stays covered at the safe location; calendar days.
- Whether contents kept in a basement are covered beyond the listed basement items; boolean.
